neighbours.label: the adjective ' engaging' / ' eclectic' (attributive, after a/an)
fire: The museum offers an engaging tour for families.
Her shop sells an eclectic mix of vintage furniture.
He wrote an engaging account of life at sea.
The festival features an eclectic lineup of bands.
Teachers want engaging lessons that hold attention.
The café has an eclectic menu of Asian and Italian dishes.
It was an engaging debate between two scientists.
Their apartment is decorated in an eclectic style.
quiet: The museum offers a guided tour for families.
Her shop sells a large mix of vintage furniture.
He wrote a detailed account of life at sea.
The festival features a long lineup of bands.
Teachers want short lessons that hold attention.
The café has a small menu of Asian and Italian dishes.
It was a long debate between two scientists.
Their apartment is decorated in a modern style.
